svg.title: Branch by Abstraction
svg.desc: Branch by Abstraction. Introduce an abstraction, build the new implementation behind it, then switch over. Step 1, Create the seam: Put an interface in front of the old client and move the callers onto it, one small commit each. Step 2, Build behind the interface: The new client grows on main and ships in every release, unused. One test suite checks both. Step 3, Switch, with a way back: Flip the flag for Reports first, then for all callers. Flipping it back takes seconds, no revert. Step 4, Clean up: Delete the old client and the switch. Main was releasable throughout: no long-lived branch.
